units.source_text: 在这根弦线没有变音以前，我俩必定相逢。”

en.t: Before the sound of this string changes, the two of us are sure to meet again."
With these words, he gave Lady Akashi his promise.

units.source_text: 但明石姬顾不得将来，只管为目前的别离而伤心饮泣，这原也是人情之常。

en.t: But Lady Akashi could not think of the future; she only grieved and wept over their present parting, which was only natural.
